fusions.name: Pilfering Strand
fusions.desc: A strand picks at a target up to 7 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, uses it up and deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Swinging Snatch
fusions.desc: Hooks a target up to 7 tiles away and swings you to it, landing a blow for 13 damage that leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Branch Hop
fusions.desc: Throws a strand to a branch and lets you step to a point up to 7 tiles away at once.

fusions.name: Idle Fingers
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
